name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari Mäkinen's career in motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a chance encounter with a rally team during his university days. Initially an engineering student, he quickly became captivated by the intricate logistics and technical challenges of keeping a racing team running smoothly. He rose through the ranks, first as a mechanic, then as a race engineer, before transitioning into operations management.

Jari's strength lies in his ability to see the big picture while maintaining a keen eye for detail. He believes that efficient operations are the backbone of any successful racing team, and he is relentless in his pursuit of optimization. His calm demeanor, even under immense pressure, allows him to make rational decisions and inspire confidence in his team. He is known for his innovative problem-solving and his dedication to creating a supportive and collaborative work environment.

At EKS JC, Jari is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the team's operations, from logistics and transportation to resource allocation and personnel management. His goal is to create a well-oiled machine that allows the drivers and engineers to focus on what they do best: winning races.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jari is a man of medium build, with a thoughtful expression etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every team briefing with a brief recap of the previous race's successes and failures.
